reading_rules.display_only: The figure displays outputs already reported; it tests nothing, is an input of no step and changes no reading of the reports that made the outputs.
reading_rules.non_rejection: angle and shape non-rejections are uninformative; a delta rejection is a difference, not specifically of size; a delta non-rejection is weak evidence (delta is conservative under the df correction).
reading_rules.motco_binding: MOTCO results are reported under the binding rules: the CV-selected rank beside angle; angle and shape non-rejections uninformative; a delta rejection a difference, not specifically of size; the covariate block and the feature filtering beside the results. The rank floor defines angle and shape in at least two dimensions without making them powerful (two dimensions, not a second axis with signal), so each analysis's configuration eigengap and null summary belong beside angle.
reading_rules.df_size: Under the df residual correction the p-values are size-controlled at the configuration MOTCO measured (six covariates, both cohort_30 tables), with delta conservative there, so a delta non-rejection stays weak evidence; the size is inferred from the mechanism (n and the reduced rank), not measured, for cohort_50, the eight-covariate latent arms, the exclusion variants, the forced ranks and the preprocessing variants.
reading_rules.sensitivity_dependence: Every analysis other than the primary is sensitivity only: a rejection status that differs from the primary's is rank, preprocessing, covariate-set, basis or cohort dependence, not a result of the variant; a CV-selected rank that differs is reported beside angle, not as better or worse; the non-rejection rules hold in every variant; the primary analysis stays primary.
reading_rules.forced_rank: The forced-rank sweep is sensitivity only: the CV-selected analysis stays primary, and a rejection status that differs between ranks is rank dependence, not a result at that rank. MOTCO's forced-rank operating characteristics are carried as limitations (Type I checked at forced 4 only, unadjusted; shape power loss and angle leakage at forced 2(K - 1); a wider angle null above n_stages - 1), and the adjusted analysis has no Type I check at any forced rank.
reading_rules.latent_adjusted_not_read: The latent_adjusted arm's angle and shape p-values are reported but not read (MOTCO's diagnosis residualized_basis: the stage latent adjustment is liberal on both at this configuration, an excess of the basis the residual correction does not address, so neither a rejection nor a non-rejection is interpretable); its delta is read under the rules above.
reading_rules.measurement_space: An axis correlated with a technical variable is a measurement-space finding about the analysis, not a reinterpretation of its statistics; the primary analysis stays primary with its non-rejection rules.
reading_rules.diagnostic: The diagnostics read sex and stage, so they are diagnostics and never a filter: their outputs feed no export, analysis or sensitivity run, and no preprocessing variant is derived from a diagnostic value.
reading_rules.stage_de_counts: The stage counts describe the stage signal in the pseudobulks; the MOTCO non-rejection rules are untouched. A zero count is none detected at this n; the union counts carry no joint error-rate claim and limma's joint F claim is approximate; a call that differs between DESeq2 and limma is method dependence, not a result of either, and agreement is not replication (same donors and counts). The FDR of padj <= alpha is approximate and Cook's handling is inactive with continuous covariates; the covariates, the feature set and each method's normalization (DESeq2's median of ratios; limma-voom's log-CPM on the export's TMM) are stated beside the counts.
reading_rules.positive_control: The positive control is about the stage signal, not the sex x stage hypothesis: it holds when E1, E2 and E3 all hold in cohort_30, and the primary-basis cohort_30 row is its outcome; cohort_50 is descriptive. If it holds, the reference's null is not a pipeline failure; if not, the latent construction is in question for any cell type. E1 does not depend on the basis; the latent_adjusted basis is a diagnosis of the primary-basis control, never a replacement (the arm is not promoted). No expectation reads a p-value.
reading_rules.span_split: MOTCO's split interaction test splits the group x stage interaction energy of the analysed features into the fitted stage-PLS span, its orthogonal complement and all of it. Only the complement is confirmatory: its pseudo-F p-value is read at alpha = 0.05, unadjusted (no adjustment across delta, angle, shape, the complement and the interaction scan, so each primary carries five tests read at alpha), and each cell type's cohort_30 primary gives the result; a complement status that differs from the primary's elsewhere is rank, preprocessing, covariate-set or cohort dependence. The span part is a concordance cell against any of delta, angle and shape rejected in the same analysis, a discordance a finding and never a result; total, the in-span share and the interaction-SS p-values are reported and not read. A complement rejection is a sex x stage difference with interaction energy outside the fitted span, not a different molecular program: it may hold leakage from an in-span difference and what the fitted span missed of the stage program, and it carries no direction, feature list or attribution. A complement non-rejection is uninformative: no power was shown at SEA-AD's stage signal, nor for sparse differences at any signal. The in-span share grows with the fitted rank and is read against no null here. Size was measured on real noise only for the astrocyte cohort_30 export at this configuration (complement 0.012); for cohort_50, microglia, the eight-covariate arm, the exclusion variants, the forced ranks and the preprocessing variants it is inferred. The test is not available with a latent adjustment.
reading_rules.interaction_scan: MOTCO's per-feature interaction scan tests each analysed feature's group x stage interaction F with the covariate-adjusted models, combined by the maximum F. Its global p-value is the one confirmatory reading, read at alpha = 0.05, unadjusted (no adjustment across delta, angle, shape, the complement and the scan, so each primary carries five tests read at alpha); a hit is a feature with step-down max-T adjusted p <= 0.05 (familywise over the scanned features), and a rejection comes with at least one hit. Each cell type's cohort_30 primary gives the result; a scan status that differs elsewhere is preprocessing, covariate-set or cohort dependence, and the forced ranks and the latent-adjusted arms equal their reference by construction (the scan reads neither the latent space nor the bootstrap). A hit names a feature whose covariate-adjusted sex difference changes across stages: a detection, not a driver (correlated neighbours can be hits too), with no geometry, trajectory or attribution, changing no reading of delta, angle, shape or the complement; the per-feature F values, the per-stage differences and the null-maximum shares are reported and not read. A non-rejection of the astrocyte cohort_30 primary carries MOTCO's power on that export (a 20-feature ramp in one sex detected in 1.000 of replicates at 3 within-stage SDs, 0.692 at 2), which excludes neither smaller effects, nor effects spread thinly over many features, nor other shapes; every other non-rejection is uninformative. Size was measured on real noise only for the astrocyte cohort_30 export at six covariates (global 0.042, familywise 0.042); elsewhere it is inferred. The null maxima lean on ATAC there (0.618 of them with half the features), and the F is the plain, unmoderated per-feature F. The scan concordance cells beside the stage DE are findings when discordant, never results.

The stage counts describe the stage signal in the pseudobulks; the MOTCO non-rejection rules are untouched. A zero count is none detected at this n; the union counts carry no joint error-rate claim and limma's joint F claim is approximate; a call that differs between DESeq2 and limma is method dependence, not a result of either, and agreement is not replication (same donors and counts). The FDR of padj <= alpha is approximate and Cook's handling is inactive with continuous covariates; the covariates, the feature set and each method's normalization (DESeq2's median of ratios; limma-voom's log-CPM on the export's TMM) are stated beside the counts.

MOTCO's split interaction test splits the group x stage interaction energy of the analysed features into the fitted stage-PLS span, its orthogonal complement and all of it. Only the complement is confirmatory: its pseudo-F p-value is read at alpha = 0.05, unadjusted (no adjustment across delta, angle, shape, the complement and the interaction scan, so each primary carries five tests read at alpha), and each cell type's cohort_30 primary gives the result; a complement status that differs from the primary's elsewhere is rank, preprocessing, covariate-set or cohort dependence. The span part is a concordance cell against any of delta, angle and shape rejected in the same analysis, a discordance a finding and never a result; total, the in-span share and the interaction-SS p-values are reported and not read. A complement rejection is a sex x stage difference with interaction energy outside the fitted span, not a different molecular program: it may hold leakage from an in-span difference and what the fitted span missed of the stage program, and it carries no direction, feature list or attribution. A complement non-rejection is uninformative: no power was shown at SEA-AD's stage signal, nor for sparse differences at any signal. The in-span share grows with the fitted rank and is read against no null here. Size was measured on real noise only for the astrocyte cohort_30 export at this configuration (complement 0.012); for cohort_50, microglia, the eight-covariate arm, the exclusion variants, the forced ranks and the preprocessing variants it is inferred. The test is not available with a latent adjustment.

Every analysis other than the primary is sensitivity only: a rejection status that differs from the primary's is rank, preprocessing, covariate-set, basis or cohort dependence, not a result of the variant; a CV-selected rank that differs is reported beside angle, not as better or worse; the non-rejection rules hold in every variant; the primary analysis stays primary.

The forced-rank sweep is sensitivity only: the CV-selected analysis stays primary, and a rejection status that differs between ranks is rank dependence, not a result at that rank. MOTCO's forced-rank operating characteristics are carried as limitations (Type I checked at forced 4 only, unadjusted; shape power loss and angle leakage at forced 2(K - 1); a wider angle null above n_stages - 1), and the adjusted analysis has no Type I check at any forced rank.

MOTCO's per-feature interaction scan tests each analysed feature's group x stage interaction F with the covariate-adjusted models, combined by the maximum F. Its global p-value is the one confirmatory reading, read at alpha = 0.05, unadjusted (no adjustment across delta, angle, shape, the complement and the scan, so each primary carries five tests read at alpha); a hit is a feature with step-down max-T adjusted p <= 0.05 (familywise over the scanned features), and a rejection comes with at least one hit. Each cell type's cohort_30 primary gives the result; a scan status that differs elsewhere is preprocessing, covariate-set or cohort dependence, and the forced ranks and the latent-adjusted arms equal their reference by construction (the scan reads neither the latent space nor the bootstrap). A hit names a feature whose covariate-adjusted sex difference changes across stages: a detection, not a driver (correlated neighbours can be hits too), with no geometry, trajectory or attribution, changing no reading of delta, angle, shape or the complement; the per-feature F values, the per-stage differences and the null-maximum shares are reported and not read. A non-rejection of the astrocyte cohort_30 primary carries MOTCO's power on that export (a 20-feature ramp in one sex detected in 1.000 of replicates at 3 within-stage SDs, 0.692 at 2), which excludes neither smaller effects, nor effects spread thinly over many features, nor other shapes; every other non-rejection is uninformative. Size was measured on real noise only for the astrocyte cohort_30 export at six covariates (global 0.042, familywise 0.042); elsewhere it is inferred. The null maxima lean on ATAC there (0.618 of them with half the features), and the F is the plain, unmoderated per-feature F. The scan concordance cells beside the stage DE are findings when discordant, never results.

Every analysis other than the primary is sensitivity only: a rejection status that differs from the primary's is rank, preprocessing, covariate-set, basis or cohort dependence, not a result of the variant; a CV-selected rank that differs is reported beside angle, not as better or worse; the non-rejection rules hold in every variant; the primary analysis stays primary.
